_meta.range: Ders 11-14 — wh + to, dolaylı emir, ilgi cümlecikleri, ortaç yapıları

lessons.title: what to do, where to go
lessons.canDo: Ne yapacağımı bilmediğimi söyleyebilir, seçenekler üzerine konuşabilirim.

concept.summary: know, decide ve wonder gibi fiillerden sonra soru kelimesiyle başlayan bir parça gelebilir. Bu parça ya tam bir cümlecik olur (where she lives) ya da kısaltılıp to alır (where to go). Kısaltma ancak özne ikisinde de aynıysa yapılabilir.

table.example: I don't know what to do.
I don't know what he wants.
I know where to go. (ben giderim)

examples.en: I don't know what to say.
She hasn't decided where to study.
Can you show me how to use this?
I wonder why he left so early.
examples.tr: Neden bu kadar erken gittiğini merak ediyorum.

examples.en: This is where I grew up.

mistakes.wrong: I don't know what I should to do.
mistakes.right: I don't know what to do.

mistakes.wrong: I don't know what does he want.
mistakes.right: I don't know what he wants.

mistakes.wrong: She decided where I to study.

exercises.text: We haven't decided ___ for the holiday.
Do you know ___ the meeting starts?
She showed me ___ the machine.
I wonder ___ he didn't call.
That café is ___ we first met.

concept.summary: Emir ve rica aktarılırken that'li cümlecik kurulmaz; kişi yazılır, ardından to'lu fiil gelir. Olumsuzunda not, to'dan önce durur. Soru aktarılırken ask kullanılır ve iç cümlede soru düzeni bozulur.

formula.right: asked + kişi + soru kelimesi + özne + fiil

table.example: They told him not to move.
He asked me where I lived.

examples.en: The teacher told us to open our books.
She asked me to help her with the boxes.
The guard told them not to take photos.
He asked me where I worked.
She asked if I could drive.

mistakes.wrong: She asked me that I wait.
He asked me where did I work.
mistakes.right: He asked me where I worked.

mistakes.wrong: The teacher said us to open our books.
mistakes.right: The teacher told us to open our books.

exercises.text: My boss ___ me to finish the report.
They told us ___ in the corridor.
She asked me what time ___ .
He asked ___ I wanted a lift.
The doctor told him ___ more water.

lessons.title: İlgi cümleciklerinde ayrıntı
lessons.topic: Non-restrictive clauses, omitted pronoun, preposition stranding
lessons.canDo: Ek bilgi verebilir, günlük dilde doğal ilgi cümlecikleri kurabilirim.

concept.summary: İlgi cümleciği iki iş görebilir: hangisinden söz ettiğimizi belirlemek ya da bilineni ek bilgiyle genişletmek. İkincisinde virgül kullanılır ve that kullanılamaz. İlgi zamiri nesne konumundaysa düşürülebilir; edat ise günlük dilde cümlenin sonunda kalır.

table.example: The man who called is my uncle.
My uncle, who lives in Bursa, called.
the person I told you about

examples.en: My sister, who works in Berlin, is visiting us.
examples.tr: Berlin'de çalışan kız kardeşim bizi ziyaret ediyor.

examples.en: The book I bought yesterday is excellent.
Who are you waiting for?
This is the colleague I work with.
The hotel, which opened last year, is already full.
examples.tr: Geçen yıl açılan otel şimdiden dolu.

mistakes.wrong: My sister, that works in Berlin, is visiting.
mistakes.right: My sister, who works in Berlin, is visiting.
mistakes.why: Virgüllü ek bilgi cümleciğinde that kullanılmaz.

mistakes.wrong: The book I bought it yesterday is excellent.
mistakes.right: The book I bought yesterday is excellent.

exercises.text: My father, ___ is 70, still works.
The film ___ we watched was boring.
That is the man I told you ___ .

Who did you go to the concert ___ ?

lessons.title: the man standing there
lessons.canDo: İki cümleyi tek cümlede toplayarak daha akıcı yazabilirim.

concept.summary: İki cümleyi birleştirmenin kısa yolu: ilgi zamiri ve yardımcı fiil atılır, geriye -ing'li parça kalır. Bu parça ya bir ismi arkadan niteler (the man standing there) ya da cümle başında zaman ve sebep bildirir (Walking home, I saw…). Her iki durumda da öznenin aynı olması gerekir.

table.example: the woman sitting by the window
Feeling tired, he went to bed.

examples.en: The man standing at the door is my neighbour.
Do you know the girl talking to Ali?
examples.tr: Ali ile konuşan kızı tanıyor musun?

examples.en: Feeling tired, she went to bed early.
Walking through the park, I saw an old friend.
examples.tr: Parkta yürürken eski bir arkadaşımı gördüm.
examples.note: Aynı özne: yürüyen de gören de ben.

examples.en: The train arriving at platform two is delayed.
examples.tr: İki numaralı perona gelen tren rötarlı.

mistakes.wrong: The man is standing at the door is my neighbour.
mistakes.right: The man standing at the door is my neighbour.

mistakes.wrong: Walking through the park, the rain started.
mistakes.right: While I was walking through the park, the rain started.
mistakes.why: Özneler farklıysa kısaltma yapılamaz; yağmur yürümüyor.

mistakes.wrong: Feeling tired, the bed was ready.
mistakes.right: Feeling tired, she went to bed.
